sections.title: Fundamentals of Nutrition
sections.description: Essentials of normal nutrition and their relationships to the health of individuals and families. These concepts serve as a basis for the development of an understanding of the therapeutic application of dietary principles and the nurse's role and responsibility in this facet of patient care. Prerequisite: Equivalent Science Sequence Course if course prerequisites not met
